feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. This review uses only the iteration 0 and 1 outcomes and the candidate's contents. Iteration 1 (score 158.144) is the best raced design: the oval finished 5 of 20 trials at mean 1.87 s with progress 0.55, while s-bend and slalom went off track in all 40 trials with progress 0.11 to 0.17 and max_error about 0.061 to 0.062 m. Steering oscillation was low (0.15 to 0.22), so the failure is early drift into bends at speed, not jitter. The candidate changes only base_speed (1.6 to 1.2) and keeps every other field from iteration 1, so the race isolates speed. The 2.5 s oval estimate is a scaling guess from 1.87 s × 1.6/1.2, not a measurement, and it leaves limited margin under the 3.0 s limit. It is a valid, single-variable test of the main hypothesis, so it is worth racing now. What to do next depends on the race. If s-bend and slalom still leave the line early (progress still well below 0.5, max_error near 0.06 m), speed is not the main cause: next widen the outer sensors to x = ±0.06 with all other values as in this candidate (H2). If the oval no longer finishes or completion_time is near 3.0 s, raise base_speed to about 1.4 as a compromise. If the oval finishes comfortably under 2.5 s and s-bend or slalom progress rises above 0.5, keep base_speed near 1.2 and tune kp or kd for the remaining bends.
requested_changes: If s-bend and slalom still go off track with progress below 0.5: keep base_speed at 1.2 and widen the outer sensors to x = -0.06 and +0.06 (the inner three stay at -0.02, 0.0, +0.02), per hypothesis H2 from iteration 1's max_error and line_loss_events.

If the oval fails to finish or completion_time approaches 3.0 s: raise base_speed to about 1.4 (not above 1.6) and keep all other fields fixed, since the iteration 1 oval finish time was 1.87 s at speed 1.6.

If s-bend and slalom progress rises above 0.5 at base_speed 1.2 without a finish: retune kp in the 3.0 to 3.5 range with kd kept at 0.3, using max_error and steering_oscillation from this race as the guide.
